Indic syllable machine: Ragel-table interpreter that tags each glyph with its syllable (serial << 4 | kind).

Ports harfrust ot/shaper/indic_machine.rs, keeping the generated tables verbatim (see indic_machine_data.nim) and translating the Ragel driver loop to Nim.

Procs

proc findSyllablesIndic(buf: var Buffer) {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Runs the syllable machine over the buffer, tagging syllables and setting the broken-syllable scratch flag. Mirrors harfrust find_syllables_indic, including the EOF transition pass.
